title: Greek professor says the Delphic women were literally possessed by the spirit of Zeus

tellings.quote: I've heard I've heard Greek uh professors say that you know these women who would become uh like as the vapors came up under the ground of Deli and the woman would become possessed with the spirit of Zeus.

plain: At Delphi in ancient Greece, the women who spoke as the oracle were literally possessed by the spirit of Zeus when vapours rose from under the ground, according to Greek professors a researcher named Luke Caverns says he has heard. Caverns tells Michels this without naming the professors. If taken at face value, it would make the oracle a real case of something entering a person, not just a ritual.
